voiceNote: Two registers, because this project writes for two readers. `site/` is written to sell and carries its own voice, defined by the author from a custom brief. Everything else is reference an agent reads and measurement tables a writer checks against, and holding those to a landing page's register would destroy what makes them useful. First matching glob wins.
note: Stet's own content, governed by Stet. `content` is everything the hook protects, and most of it is reference: measurement tables and rule lists an agent reads to decide what to do. `prose` is the subset written to be read by a person choosing whether to use this, and it is the only thing a voice should ever be applied to. Rewriting a column of sentence-length figures in somebody's house voice destroys the thing that made it useful.
